newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF likely to offer 10-yr JGBs on Wed -- sources.
newsitem.headline: MOF likely to offer 10-yr JGBs on Wed -- sources.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) is likely to offer 10-year Japanese government bonds, partly through a price-competitive auction, on Wednesday next week, market sources said on Friday.
The amount of the offer is expected to be about 1.6 trillion yen, of which about 60 percent is to be issued through the auction. Bond traders said the coupon will likely be set at around 2.9 percent.
An auction of two-year government notes is likely to follow on Friday, sources added.
